reading.origin: actual research LLM subtask from SciFact r4
reading.question: Read and verify original SciFact paper and at least one reproducible/lightweight method source. Focus on exact task definition, labels, evidence/candidate document setting, official train/dev/test or splits, input/output and evaluation metrics (accuracy, macro-F1), and methodological ideas suitable for CPU such as TF-IDF lexical retrieval plus entailment classification. Return precise source citations and evidence IDs with claims supported by original text; do not rely on abstracts alone.
reading.scope: Real production child research with live web search and verification; repeat of a failed question, not a paired causal benchmark
